title: Slashy
summary: The AI assistant that does email for you
content: Slashy: The AI assistant that does email for you | Product Hunt Launching today Slashy Launching today The AI assistant that does email for you 688 followers The AI assistant that does email for you 688 followers Visit website Email clients Slashy is an AI-native email client and assistant that drafts replies in your voice, triages what matters, and makes sure no follow-up slips, so you spend less time in your inbox and more time on what matters. It connects to your email, calendar, CRM, and meeting notes and learns how you work, so you can ask Slashy to prep you for your next meeting, draft a follow-up, clear your inbox to zero, track who still owes you a reply, or fire off an email from iMessage or Slack while you're on the go. A few months ago we sat down and asked ourselves a simple question: why did every AI tool we used to write email suck? They could all write. But the drafts were generic. They didn't know who we were talking to, what we'd already said, what got discussed in the last meeting, or how we actually write. No context. No memory. You'd paste in the same background every single time and still get something that sounded like a press release instead of you. And none of them actually did anything. They'd hand you a draft, but never notice the follow-up you forgot or clear the noise out of your inbox. So we built Slashy. Slashy is an AI-native email client and assistant that drafts replies in your voice, triages what matters, and makes sure no follow-up slips. The drafts actually sound like you, not the generic AI slop you can spot a mile away, because Slashy connects to your calendar, CRM, and meeting notes for real context, and learns how you write. Git backups capture repositories, metadata, and LFS; Linear backups capture the whole workspace - issues, projects, cycles, documents, and more. content: Conan: A native Mac cockpit for Claude Code | Product Hunt Launching today Conan Launching today A native Mac cockpit for Claude Code 178 followers A native Mac cockpit for Claude Code 178 followers Visit website Terminals • AI Workflow Automation Conan is a native macOS app that wraps Claude Code in a live HUD — every prompt, tool call, skill, and token, surfaced as it happens. Overview Reviews Alternatives Team More Free Launch tags: Mac • Developer Tools • Artificial Intelligence Launch Team Show more Show more Launching Today # 7 Day Rank Upvote • 120 points Follow Conan Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info conan.sh Conan Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/conan Similar Products cmux The open-source terminal built for coding agents 5.0 ( 1 review ) Terminals Caudex Terminal for Claude Code with GUI controls Terminals AI Code Editors Maestri An infinite canvas where coding agents work in concert 5.0 ( 1 review ) AI Coding Agents Terminals SessionCast CLI control to monitor and work with Claude Code remotely Terminals Vibespace Workspace for multi-agent collaboration AI Workflow Automation View more Subscribe Sign in Framer Launch websites with enterprise needs at startup speeds. Try Framer Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Randy Daniel Maker 📌 Hey Product Hunt 👋 I'm Randy. I use Claude Code all day, and I kept losing track of what it was actually doing. It'd go heads-down for two minutes firing tools and burning context, and the terminal showed me everything except what I cared about. Which tools did it just run? How full is the context window? I ended up with a usage CLI in one tab, a cost tool in another, and a statusline I had to squint at. I didn't want three side-tools. I wanted one surface to glance at. A cockpit. So I built Conan, a native macOS app that sits beside Claude Code and turns its live session into a HUD: - a streaming timeline of every prompt, tool call, and skill as it fires - a context-window gauge you watch fill - a usage and cost pulse It reads Claude Code's local data. No telemetry, nothing about your code or prompts ever leaves the machine. It's free to use. A one-time $29 unlocks Premium, no subscription, lifetime 1.x updates. macOS-first today; Windows and Linux folks can grab the waitlist. I'd love your honest feedback, especially from people who live in Claude Code. What would make this a daily driver for you? Try it → https://www.conan.sh Upvote (2) Report Share 7d ago Moh @randydigital Interesting idea. One thing I’ve noticed with Claude Code is that the more information you expose, the more cognitive load you can accidentally create. At what point does the HUD become another dashboard people monitor instead of something that helps them stay focused? I’m also curious whether users actually change their behavior after seeing token usage, tool calls, and context consumption in real time, or if it’s mostly reassurance that the agent is doing what they expect. content: Allergo: Translate your allergies, anywhere. | Product Hunt Launching today Allergo Launching today Translate your allergies, anywhere. 171 followers Translate your allergies, anywhere. 171 followers Visit website Translation Allergo helps you create allergy translation cards for 75+ languages/countries. Add cards to Apple Wallet for quick access anywhere. Features also include conversation helpers and emergency SOS translations, automatically translated to the users location. Designed for real-world use, with localisation across countries. Professional translations, and more native speaker verifications, are coming soon via over-the-air updates. Built for anyone travelling with allergies or dietary restrictions. Overview Reviews Alternatives Built with Team More Free Options Launch tags: Health & Fitness • Travel • Health Launch Team / Built With Show more Show more Launching Today # 8 Day Rank Upvote • 105 points Follow Allergo Add to collection Share Analytics Company Info getallergo.com Allergo Info Launched in 2026 Forum p/allergo-allergy-translation-cards Similar Products Emma Intelligence Eat better with Emma 4.9 ( 26 reviews ) Allert Allergy flashcard generator for travellers Peanut Allergy Offline translator for people allergic to peanuts Rakun Card - Special Needs Travel A card to show your special needs like ADHD or allergies Travel Planning Travel apps Felo Translator A real time translation APP by AI(GPT - 4) 4.8 ( 6 reviews ) View more Subscribe Sign in Krisp Voice Translation Speech-to-speech translation API Try Krisp Voice Translation Promoted What do you think? … Login to comment Ben Poarch Hunter 📌 Hey everyone 👋 I built Allergo after years of struggling to explain my food allergies while travelling - especially in places where even small translation differences can completely change the meaning. One moment that really stuck with me was realising that the word for “peanut” isn’t consistent across Spanish-speaking countries. That’s when I started thinking there should be something more reliable than Google Translate or standard allergy cards. Allergo focuses on: • Clear allergy communication (not generic translation) • Localised wording depending on country (work in progress) • Simple cards you can show in restaurants, available in-app and in Apple Wallet It’s still early, so I’d genuinely love feedback - especially from anyone who travels with allergies or manages them for family members. Happy to answer any questions, and really appreciate any support 🙏 Upvote (3) Report Share 1mo ago Anna Ludwinowski @benpoarch Congrats on the launch! Very interesting and useful product. I have a sister with a severe peanut allergy, so I've seen what a struggle dining out can be. And when you add language as a barrier, the frustration (and risk) becomes real. Upvote (1) Report Share 17h ago Javier Castillo @benpoarch i love when solutions come from a real problems and more when you are living the problem!! congrats i love it. Upvote Report Sha
